    • Method Detail

      • getProtocolName

        String getProtocolName()
        Get the protocol name for this score objective. This name is for internal use only. It can be thought of as the "key" or "identifier" of this score objective.
        Returns:
        The protocol name.

      • getScoreObjectiveCriteria

        ScoreObjectiveCriteria getScoreObjectiveCriteria()
        Gets the ScoreObjectiveCriteria for this ScoreObjective.
        Returns:
        The score Objective Criteria.

      • getDisplayName

        String getDisplayName()
        Gets the display name for this ScoreObjective. This is the name that will be seen in game by players.
        Returns:
        The display name.

        Sets and updates the display name to all clients.

        name - The name you wish to set the display name to.
